stimulus_duration.source: Cuppini 2011, pp. 10–14, Peri-hand Model Description, Basal Results and Figs. 7–11; Cuppini 2011, pp. 3, 10, 14 and References pp. 20–21
stimulus_duration.gap: The 2010a proof reports an approximately 400 ms assessment run with touch held from t0 = 0, and a 300 ms awareness readout without a separate within-run cue offset. The reviewed 2011 source reports approximately steady-state activity without giving cue offset, run duration, integration step or convergence rule. The 30 ms cue in the 2009/2010 spatial-attention study has a separate protocol and precedes a sustained target.
